original_statement:
What did you do? List the exact steps to reproduce, in order. No script or test under scripts/ or test/ inspects src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol or src/nitro/ for ERC-4626 imports or calls to convertToAssets, convertToShares, previewDeposit, previewMint, previewRedeem or previewWithdraw.
What did you expect to happen? A check script scans src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol and src/nitro/*.sol. Checks: (a) behavior: 'python3 scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py' prints JSON {files_scanned: <n>, erc4626_imports: [], rate_calls: []} with files_scanned >= 2; (b) behavior: 'python3 scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py --self-test' scans a temporary file containing 'convertToAssets(' and prints JSON {self_test_detected: true}.
What actually happened? Include the exact error text or output. Nothing checks the settlement code for rate reads.
Which surface or component? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol and src/nitro/
What environment and version? (OS, app/gateway build or commit, network) armada-nitro integrated; forge
Is it reproducible? (always / intermittently / once) — and how often. always
What is the impact / severity? Who is blocked and how badly? Design 15 requires settlement to use no exchange rate; a later change could import ERC-4626 or call a rate function without any check failing.
What activity was underway when this was found? (ODC Activity — e.g. testing, code review, normal usage, reproduction attempt) design review for E11
What condition or event exposed the defect? (ODC Trigger — e.g. a config change, concurrent access, a boundary/edge-case input, an unusual workload) reading the settlement code against design 15
restatement: Design 15 for armada-nitro requires that settlement logic never compute an amount through an exchange-rate conversion. Today no script or test under scripts/ or test/ inspects src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol or src/nitro/ for an ERC-4626 import or for a call to convertToAssets, convertToShares, previewDeposit, previewMint, previewRedeem, or previewWithdraw. Without such a check, a later change could introduce one of these rate-dependent calls into the settlement path and no automated check would catch it. The request is to add a standing guard script, scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py, that scans src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol and every file under src/nitro/*.sol for ERC-4626 imports and for calls to the six listed rate-conversion functions. Run with no arguments, the script reports in JSON how many files it scanned and lists any ERC-4626 imports or rate-conversion calls it found. Against the current codebase it must report files_scanned of 2 or more and empty lists for both findings, confirming the design-15 invariant holds today. Run with a --self-test flag, the script must scan a temporary file engineered to contain a convertToAssets( call and report that it detected the call, proving the scanner can actually recognize a violation rather than always reporting a clean result.

restatement_clauses.text: A script at scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py scans src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol and src/nitro/*.sol, and running 'python3 scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py' prints JSON {files_scanned: <n>, erc4626_imports: [], rate_calls: []} with files_scanned >= 2.
Running 'python3 scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py --self-test' scans a temporary file containing 'convertToAssets(' and prints JSON {self_test_detected: true}.

goal: Add an automated guard script that confirms the armada-nitro settlement contracts contain no ERC-4626 exchange-rate imports or calls, and that the guard can actually detect such a call when one is present.
acceptance_criteria: Running the settlement rate-check tool against the adjudicator and nitro contracts shows it looked at two or more files and found zero exchange-rate imports and zero exchange-rate function calls.
Running the tool in its self-check mode against a sample file that contains an exchange-rate function call shows it found that call.
